en-US.name: Echo Show Remote
en-US.summary: Companion skill for the Echo Show Remote app — control your Echo devices from your phone.
en-US.description:
Echo Show Remote gives you a full-featured smartphone remote for every Echo device. Enable this skill and link your account to unlock playback controls, volume, smart home routines, and text-based Alexa commands right from your phone.

Features:
• Play, pause, skip, and volume control from your phone
• Trigger any Alexa routine you've created
• Send text commands to Alexa without speaking
• Works with every Echo Show, Echo Dot, and Echo device on your account
examplePhrases: Alexa, tell Echo Show Remote to play music
Alexa, ask Echo Show Remote for help

publishingInformation.testingInstructions:
1. Enable the skill in the Alexa app.
2. Complete account linking with any email/password (test account: test@example.com / test1234).
3. Say 'Alexa, open Echo Show Remote'.
4. From the companion phone app, tap any control — the command flows through this skill to your Echo device.
